resources.string: The app did not close properly last time. You can send a report to the developer to help fix the problem: it contains records of the app session and basic device information, and no personal data. You can review the email before sending it, or share the report zip file with the developer directly instead.
The report was shared. If you picked your email app, review the email there, then send it. You can also share the report zip file with the developer directly, through any other app.
Attach this file to the email which was just opened, then send it, or share the zip file with the developer directly instead. The file will be deleted when you close this message!

No email app could be opened. Email this file to %1$s, or share the zip file with the developer directly instead: the address was copied to the clipboard. The file will be deleted when you close this message!
The report could not be prepared.
